description: This Java class `FilterUtil` provides utility methods for managing locale-related user and system properties in the OpenMRS system. It handles retrieving and storing locale preferences, reading global properties, and interacting with the database for user properties and system defaults.

classes.name: FilterUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing locale settings within the OpenMRS system, including retrieval and storage of user and default system locales, with database interactions.

methods.name: restoreLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the locale preference for a specified user, defaulting to system global settings or a default locale if none are set.

methods.name: readSystemDefaultLocale
methods.description: Reads the system's default locale from global properties, optionally using an existing database connection.

methods.name: storeLocale
methods.description: Stores a specified locale in the database as both a user property for the admin user and as the global default locale.

methods.name: getUserIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves a user's database ID given their username or system ID.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyValue
methods.description: Fetches the value of a specified global property directly from the database.
